<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Hop Hop</title>
<style>html,body{margin:0;background:#111;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;height:100vh}</style>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@3.80.1/dist/phaser.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
<script>
// Level maps: # = ground, C = coin, E = enemy, P = player start, F = flag (exit)
const LEVELS = [
  [
    "                                        ",
    "                                        ",
    "                                        ",
    "                       C C              ",
    "                      #####          F  ",
    "           C C                      ### ",
    "          #####           C C           ",
    "    C                    ####           ",
    "   ###          E                       ",
    " P        C C C C C C       C    C      ",
    "########################  ###  ####  ###",
  ],
  [
    "                                        ",
    "                                   F    ",
    "                     C   C   C   ####   ",
    "                    ##  ##  ##          ",
    "             C                          ",
    "            ###                         ",
    "      C            E                    ",
    "     ###     C C C C C C C              ",
    " P         ###############    C         ",
    "                             ###        ",
    "####    ###              #         ##   ",
  ],
];
const T = 32;

class Boot extends Phaser.Scene {
  constructor(){ super('boot'); }
  create(){
    const g = this.add.graphics();
    const tex = (key, w, h, draw) => { g.clear(); draw(); g.generateTexture(key, w, h); };
    tex('ground', T, T, () => { g.fillStyle(0x6b4a2b).fillRect(0,0,T,T); g.fillStyle(0x4caf50).fillRect(0,0,T,8); });
    tex('player', 24, 30, () => { g.fillStyle(0x3fa9f5).fillRoundedRect(0,0,24,30,5); g.fillStyle(0xffffff).fillRect(14,7,6,6); g.fillStyle(0x000000).fillRect(17,9,3,3); });
    tex('coin', 16, 16, () => { g.fillStyle(0xffd23f).fillCircle(8,8,8); g.fillStyle(0xfff3a0).fillCircle(6,6,3); });
    tex('enemy', 28, 22, () => { g.fillStyle(0xe63946).fillRoundedRect(0,0,28,22,8); g.fillStyle(0xffffff).fillRect(5,5,6,6).fillRect(17,5,6,6); g.fillStyle(0x000000).fillRect(7,7,3,3).fillRect(19,7,3,3); });
    tex('flag', 24, 64, () => { g.fillStyle(0xdddddd).fillRect(0,0,4,64); g.fillStyle(0x2ec4b6).fillTriangle(4,2,24,12,4,22); });
    g.destroy();
    this.scene.start('title');
  }
}

class Title extends Phaser.Scene {
  constructor(){ super('title'); }
  create(){
    const {width:w, height:h} = this.scale;
    this.add.text(w/2, h/2-50, 'HOP HOP', {fontSize:'56px', color:'#ffd23f', fontStyle:'bold'}).setOrigin(.5);
    this.add.text(w/2, h/2+20, 'Arrows / WASD to move, Up / W / Space to jump (twice!)\nCollect coins, stomp or dodge the enemy, reach the flag.', {fontSize:'16px', color:'#fff', align:'center'}).setOrigin(.5);
    this.add.text(w/2, h/2+90, 'Press SPACE to start', {fontSize:'22px', color:'#2ec4b6'}).setOrigin(.5);
    this.input.keyboard.once('keydown-SPACE', () => this.scene.start('game', {level:0, score:0}));
  }
}

class Game extends Phaser.Scene {
  constructor(){ super('game'); }
  init(d){ this.levelIndex = d.level; this.score = d.score; this.levelStartScore = d.score; this.done = false; }
  create(){
    const map = LEVELS[this.levelIndex];
    const W = map[0].length * T, H = map.length * T;
    this.cameras.main.setBackgroundColor(this.levelIndex ? '#2b2d42' : '#87ceeb');
    this.physics.world.setBounds(0, 0, W, H + 200);
    this.physics.world.setBoundsCollision(true, true, true, false); // open bottom so you can fall

    this.ground = this.physics.add.staticGroup();
    this.coins = this.physics.add.staticGroup();
    let start = {x:T, y:T}, enemyPos, flagPos;
    map.forEach((row, r) => [...row].forEach((ch, c) => {
      const x = c*T + T/2, y = r*T + T/2;
      if (ch === '#') this.ground.create(x, y, 'ground');
      else if (ch === 'C') this.coins.create(x, y, 'coin');
      else if (ch === 'P') start = {x, y};
      else if (ch === 'E') enemyPos = {x, y};
      else if (ch === 'F') flagPos = {x, y: y - 16};
    }));

    this.player = this.physics.add.sprite(start.x, start.y, 'player').setCollideWorldBounds(true);
    this.player.body.setMaxVelocityY(700);
    this.jumps = 0;

    this.enemy = this.physics.add.sprite(enemyPos.x, enemyPos.y, 'enemy');
    this.enemy.setVelocityX(-80).setBounce(0).setCollideWorldBounds(true);

    this.flag = this.physics.add.staticImage(flagPos.x, flagPos.y, 'flag');

    this.physics.add.collider(this.player, this.ground);
    this.physics.add.collider(this.enemy, this.ground);
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.coins, (p, coin) => {
      coin.destroy(); this.score += 10; this.updateHud();
      this.tweens.add({targets: this.add.text(coin.x, coin.y, '+10', {fontSize:'14px', color:'#fff'}).setOrigin(.5), y: coin.y-30, alpha:0, duration:500});
    });
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.enemy, () => this.hitEnemy());
    this.physics.add.overlap(this.player, this.flag, () => this.finish());

    this.cameras.main.setBounds(0, 0, W, H).startFollow(this.player, true, 0.15, 0.15);

    this.keys = this.input.keyboard.addKeys('LEFT,RIGHT,UP,A,D,W,SPACE');
    this.hud = this.add.text(10, 10, '', {fontSize:'18px', color:'#fff', stroke:'#000', strokeThickness:3}).setScrollFactor(0);
    this.updateHud();
  }
  updateHud(){ this.hud.setText(`Level ${this.levelIndex+1}/${LEVELS.length}   Score ${this.score}   Coins left ${this.coins.countActive()}`); }

  hitEnemy(){
    if (!this.enemy.active || this.done) return;
    const p = this.player.body;
    if (p.velocity.y > 0 && p.bottom < this.enemy.body.top + 12) { // stomp
      this.enemy.disableBody(true, true);
      this.player.setVelocityY(-350); this.jumps = 1;
      this.score += 50; this.updateHud();
      this.cameras.main.shake(100, 0.005);
    } else this.die();
  }
  die(){
    if (this.done) return; this.done = true;
    this.physics.pause(); this.player.setTint(0xff0000);
    this.cameras.main.fade(500, 0, 0, 0);
    this.time.delayedCall(550, () => this.scene.restart({level:this.levelIndex, score:this.levelStartScore}));
  }
  finish(){
    if (this.done) return; this.done = true;
    this.physics.pause();
    const next = this.levelIndex + 1;
    this.cameras.main.fade(400, 255, 255, 255);
    this.time.delayedCall(450, () => next < LEVELS.length
      ? this.scene.start('game', {level:next, score:this.score})
      : this.scene.start('win', {score:this.score}));
  }

  update(){
    if (this.done) return;
    const k = this.keys, p = this.player, onFloor = p.body.blocked.down;
    const left = k.LEFT.isDown || k.A.isDown, right = k.RIGHT.isDown || k.D.isDown;
    p.setVelocityX(left ? -200 : right ? 200 : 0);
    if (left) p.setFlipX(true); else if (right) p.setFlipX(false);

    if (onFloor) this.jumps = 0;
    const jp = Phaser.Input.Keyboard.JustDown;
    if (jp(k.UP) || jp(k.W) || jp(k.SPACE)) {
      if (onFloor || this.jumps < 2) {
        if (!onFloor && this.jumps === 0) this.jumps = 1; // walked off ledge: only air jump remains
        this.jumps++;
        p.setVelocityY(-420);
      }
    }
    // variable jump height
    if (p.body.velocity.y < 0 && !(k.UP.isDown || k.W.isDown || k.SPACE.isDown)) p.setVelocityY(p.body.velocity.y * 0.85);

    // enemy patrol: turn at walls and ledges
    const e = this.enemy;
    if (e.active) {
      const b = e.body;
      if (b.blocked.left) e.setVelocityX(80);
      else if (b.blocked.right) e.setVelocityX(-80);
      else if (b.blocked.down) {
        const aheadX = b.velocity.x < 0 ? b.left - 2 : b.right + 2;
        const hasGround = this.ground.getChildren().some(t => t.getBounds().contains(aheadX, b.bottom + 4));
        if (!hasGround) e.setVelocityX(-b.velocity.x);
      }
      e.setFlipX(b.velocity.x > 0);
    }

    if (p.y > this.physics.world.bounds.height - 150) this.die();
  }
}

class Win extends Phaser.Scene {
  constructor(){ super('win'); }
  create(d){
    const {width:w, height:h} = this.scale;
    this.cameras.main.setBackgroundColor('#1b4332');
    this.add.text(w/2, h/2-50, 'YOU WIN!', {fontSize:'60px', color:'#ffd23f', fontStyle:'bold'}).setOrigin(.5);
    this.add.text(w/2, h/2+20, `Final score: ${d.score}`, {fontSize:'26px', color:'#fff'}).setOrigin(.5);
    this.add.text(w/2, h/2+80, 'Press SPACE to play again', {fontSize:'20px', color:'#2ec4b6'}).setOrigin(.5);
    this.input.keyboard.once('keydown-SPACE', () => this.scene.start('title'));
  }
}

new Phaser.Game({
  type: Phaser.AUTO, width: 800, height: 352, pixelArt: true,
  physics: { default: 'arcade', arcade: { gravity: { y: 1000 } } },
  scene: [Boot, Title, Game, Win],
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

I built the platformer as a single file, `index.html`, in your working directory. I haven't run it in a browser. I tried a quick syntax check with Node, but it needed a permission I didn't have, so I skipped it. Treat it as untested until you open it.

**To play:** open `index.html` in a browser. It loads Phaser 3.80 from a CDN, so you need to be online. If your browser blocks local files, run `python3 -m http.server` in the folder and go to `localhost:8000`.

**What's in it:**
- **Player:** move with arrows or WASD; jump with Up, W or Space. You can jump once more in mid-air, and if you walk off a ledge you still get that one air jump. Letting go of the key early gives a shorter jump.
- **Coins:** 10 points each. The HUD shows your score and how many coins are left.
- **Enemy:** a red blob that walks back and forth and turns around at walls and ledges. Landing on it is worth 50 points and bounces you up. Touching it any other way kills you.
- **2 levels:** a daytime level and a harder night level. Each is drawn as a text grid and the camera scrolls to follow you. Reaching the flag takes you to the next level.
- **Death:** falling into a pit or touching the enemy restarts the current level and resets your score to what it was when you started that level.
- **Screens:** title screen → level 1 → level 2 → win screen with your final score. Press Space on the win screen to play again.

All the graphics are simple shapes drawn in code, so there are no image files to load.

**To edit levels:** change the `LEVELS` grids at the top of the script. `#` is ground, `C` a coin, `E` the enemy, `P` the player start and `F` the flag.

I worked out the jump heights against the platform gaps on paper, not by playing. In level 1 that showed the last climb to the flag was too high, so I added a small step platform. The level 2 route should work with double jumps, but a real playthrough may still find jumps that are too hard.
